sessionNotes.title: Experiment 0
sessionNotes.text: Rolled our stats, decided class race and background. Background of compaign is a continent/planet taken over by evil scientists, we are test subjects. Encountered a minion, won in 2 turns, no damage taken, no resources used.

additionalNotes.title: Backstory
additionalNotes.text: Autognomes are creations of ancient artificers. I was created at some point, but I have no memory. Since I have gained consciousness, I have not met my creator. Through years of learning from left over literature in the lab, I learned of the world around me. One day, upon reading the remnants of a scroll, a jolt of energy shot through me, and I encountered a magnificent figure, one I could only describe as "holy". This figure chose me for some unknown reasons, and I became a peace cleric. What I haven't realized at this point, was that I had gained something most Autognomes dream of (if they can dream): emotions.
